folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation: chronology-contract applicability, 2026-11-04 (B355)
folds.body:
L1–L5 remain useful for selected source/lore work: evidence quality, continuity, claim type and project acceptance are independent; occurrence, discovery, publication and actor knowledge must not be collapsed. The stable event/causal map records actual support and uncertainty rather than inventing exact dates or a world law from genre expectation. A causal expansion is a labeled proposal until its actual authority and implementation say otherwise. A linked source/reference remains unread unless its own content was inspected.

The opening acquisition scope and local research path describe October 11 work, not an instruction to collect books during this reconciliation. Current library/coverage/tool owners govern any future authorized acquisition; inaccessible material stays an explicit gap. Public franchise information and private altered/randomized truths follow current sealed-secret rules, while raw source/recreation material retains its private storage boundary. No new source corpus, private report or lore claim was inspected here.

L5 closes its frozen inspected range, not an entire work or every future world. Baseline/disturbance/delay/knowledge scenarios and persistence checks apply where a selected implementation actually changes those behaviors. They do not create a new all-world event engine, require every research pass to implement gameplay or supersede current priorities. Source manifests, locators and exact proof states must remain with their owners; no research-completion or runtime acceptance is newly asserted by this fold.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation: historical audit prompt, 2026-11-04 (B355)
folds.body:
The C0/optional-start/CH1 list is explicitly a set of claims to verify. Merge or bundle labels and “or later” do not establish unchanged behavior on later inputs. This prompt does not itself prove awakening, concealment, durable reveal, backwards compatibility or stage-1 readiness. Use the actual existing result and relevant current source before dispatching another audit. The old new-chat/paste instruction, full-suite recipe and fixed 1366/1440 matrix are historical workflow, not current authorization or a universal rerun requirement. Current host instructions and desktop/font targets govern selected execution.

Preserve natural versus seeded-native versus source evidence, gate counterexamples, discoverability, exact known/held/dormant semantics, failed-import protection and native ownership side effects. Ordinary exported metadata, hidden labels and settings can have different discovery boundaries; test the actual supported route rather than assuming a panel’s absence proves every hidden name stays concealed. A reduced-motion reveal count and a combat animation count are not interchangeable. Save/reload and literal import are separate boundaries.

Stage 0’s informational design and a proposed stage-1 slice are distinct from the broader any-source cheat direction. Current quiet base-faculty direction does not require every character to acquire a voiced quest system or a status-window UI. Conversely, an actually selected source can grant real power. Reuse current title/quest/claim/save owners and preserve proposals without silently granting scope. The original read-only audit constraints remain history; the current user request authorizes this documentation reconciliation, not execution of the embedded prompt or a fresh chat/worker.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation: micro-UX measurements and applicability, 2026-11-04 (B355)
folds.body:
The eight fixture/scheme/viewport rows, eleven resting/control color rows and MX1–MX29 retain their original detached-snapshot identity. Their main distinction remains useful: readable text/zero horizontal overflow is not useful arrival or F6 reachability. The ranked placement, speaker/time identification, explanation, empty-copy and numeric-alignment ideas are proposals tied to those observations. Old 1366/1920 captures do not replace current desktop/font proof, and the separately excluded awakening worker prevents treating this snapshot as the later combined UI.

Keep measured scopes precise: five fixture stat values plus shared formatting source are not an exhaustive rounding sweep; card-state hover/focus stability is not a whole-economy nonmutation check; source-derived filtering is not an executed filter click. Day-boundary reduced motion and one normal first-win reveal do not prove every animation frame, sleep/offline boundary or repeated-message soak. Appearance/collapse preferences are not automatically character progression. Successful resting contrast leaves custom palettes, screen readers and true zoom unverified.

The corrected canvas color probe supersedes its invalid oklab parser; setup errors were not UX defects. MX29’s corrected two-authority XP fixture is seeded-native despite its inherited NATURAL log label. The failed XP seed and hero overlay did not test level-up. Its same-victory ordering and the separate 30.032-second automated natural first-win route prove those two routes only; neither is a general player pacing estimate. The automatic “Saved the game manually” receipt is a specific observed copy issue, not an actual manual click. Current source status of any proposed fix is unverified here.

Stage-0 absence of claims, paid controls, quest sorting, unread history and reward queues is scoped inapplicability, not failure to ship every palette row. Future event identity, message compaction, focus and projection requirements belong to their selected consumers. Preserve both reduced-motion accessibility and legitimate source-specific capabilities without imposing speculative future stages. No artifact, source, screenshot, fixture, browser or gameplay check was rerun by this content review.
